list: Official 55 trophies as published by PlayStation (Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026): 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list. Every guide below is written in our own words from the official description; where the description names no place or step, the guide says so instead of inventing one. Sources are cited per trophy.

trophies.guide: The platinum lands automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work through the roadmap in order — story, side strands, activities, then collectible cleanup — and it pops with the last trophy you need. Keep this tracker updated so you always know which trophy is your final one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so you cannot miss it — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen. This is your first story trophy and the start of Stage 1 of the roadmap.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies pop when the chapter's final mission ends, so keep playing the story in order and do not rush past the chapter's closing mission. If the game offers mission replay, a missed chapter trophy can be retried from the replay menu — check there before starting a new save.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it pops at the chapter's final mission, so play the story through in order. The name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This is the mid-story checkpoint — by now you should also be chipping away at side activities between missions, since several activity trophies are easier while you are travelling across Leonida for the story anyway.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Once this pops you are on the run-in to the finale, so before you start the final mission, sweep up any mission-tied trophies you have not earned yet — several named-mission trophies sit in this same stage of the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. It is a gold trophy and the end of Stage 1, so treat it as a point of no return: finish every other story-mission trophy first, and save the game in a separate slot before you start the finale so you can go back if a mission trophy did not pop.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. The description names the mission and nothing else, so there is no special method — play the mission through to its end. Because it is tied to one named mission, do it when the story offers it and check the mission-replay menu if it ever fails to pop.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in GTA usually have setup steps first, so finish every setup the story asks for and then the heist itself — the trophy pops at the end of the heist, not at the setups.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Another single-mission trophy: play it when the story offers it and it pops at the mission-complete screen. If you are following the roadmap in order you will reach it naturally in Stage 1.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy name is stylised with no vowels, exactly as PlayStation publishes it. Finish the mission in full; the trophy is tied to that one mission only.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Expect a combat-heavy mission around the airport — bring armour and a full weapon loadout before you start it, since the trophy only pops if you finish the mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name suggests a large set-piece mission, so stock up before you start and follow the mission objectives to the end — the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the in-game stats screen. This is the second gold trophy and the real endgame grind: it counts story, side missions, activities and collectibles together, so it usually pops very late — often as one of your last trophies before the platinum. Use this tracker as your checklist and the stats screen as the source of truth for what is still missing.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all count toward the total, and it accumulates across the whole playthrough. The fastest way is to chain small stunts while driving between missions instead of grinding them in one sitting: take jumps, thread traffic and use ramps whenever you travel. The in-game stats screen tracks your running total.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (count)
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one session of each is enough, you do not need to win or master any of them. Work down the list: fishing, racing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and whatever the ninth activity is in your game, and tick each off here as you try it. Do this early so you learn which activities you enjoy before grinding their trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: learn each challenge's target pattern, use the right weapon for its range, and take your time on the aim — rushing the shots is what costs the gold. Retry any challenge on the spot until it turns gold; failed attempts do not lock you out.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (count: 42)
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at every one — a second place does not count for that spot. Learn the racing line on your first run, then push on the second; drone races reward clean lines more than raw speed, so avoid clipping gates.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not 20 wins on the same one. Spread across race types and locations, and count each new event you win here. Races you already won for other trophies (like the drone races) may count toward this total if they are race events, so check your count after each win.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so watch what Cal catches and beat his haul rather than fishing at random — use the best bait and spot you have unlocked and keep your line in the water. If you lose, challenge him again; the trophy only needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish it, not just start it. Pick the shortest game in the arcade first and play it through to its end screen. Arcade games are quick, so this is one of the easiest trophies in Stage 3.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission — the last job in his strand. Side-character finales like this one can be easy to leave behind once the main story heats up, so clear Andy's strand before the final story mission. If the strand stops offering missions, check the map for his marker before moving the story on.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Same pattern as the other character finales: finish his whole strand in Stage 2, before the story finale, and do not let his last mission sit unfinished while you push the main story forward.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's strand is one of five character finales in this list, so clear them as a group in Stage 2 — when a character's marker appears on the map, go and do it rather than saving them all for after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers on the map — talk to each one and finish their whole strand, not just the first mission. Eight full strands is the count, so keep a list of who you have finished here and sweep the map region by region so nobody is left half-done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Another character finale for Stage 2 — finish Randy's strand before the story finale, and if his missions stop appearing, check the map and your contacts before assuming the strand is done.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission — the last of the five named character finales. With all five done, Stage 2 is nearly complete; the remaining side work is the stranger strands and the collectibles.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places, so they are easy to walk past — check each region of the map in turn and tick spots off here as you sit at them. Pair this with exploring Leonida for the area trophy so one trip covers both.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Unique hunts are one specific animal, so follow Bret's instructions and the trail markers rather than hunting at random — the right animal is the only one that counts. Bring a scoped weapon and approach quietly so you do not scare it off before the shot.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida, so this is a Stage 4 cleanup trophy: explore thoroughly, check the places other collectibles hide, and trade or track duplicates if the game allows it. Finishing three whole sets takes patience — start collecting early and finish the sets at the end.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. This is a volume trophy, so weave it into everything else: WAiNK at every new place you visit instead of saving it for a grind at the end. The count is locations, not uses, so repeating the same spot does not help — keep moving.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals the game tracks — stunts, kills, driving feats and more — and they stack up naturally across a full playthrough. Check the challenges menu often and steer toward the ones nearly done; 50 is reachable well before the end if you keep an eye on it.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose the cops and escape. The partner must be with you for it to count, so start the wanted level together, then break line of sight, hide, and wait for the search to end. Do not let your partner get caught — if the escape fails, build the wanted level again and retry.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — keep the heat on the whole time. Plan a route of three close shops, rob fast, move fast, and do not let the cops drop off before the third robbery. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each one and it counts as discovered. Variety is the point, so try every vehicle type you see: cars, bikes, boats, planes and anything unusual. Check the vehicle log to see what you still need and hunt the rare ones last.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up: gather a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it ends. A busy shootout with enemies close together is the best place — do not waste the activation on one or two stragglers.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA in a way the airport did not schedule. That means grabbing a plane and taking off without following the normal departure routine. Expect airport security to notice, so be ready for a wanted level on the way out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the tanks. Get into a Rhino tank and cause chaos with it until the trophy pops. The exact trigger is not spelled out in the official description, so try surviving and scoring takedowns in the tank; if it does not pop quickly, check the community guides linked in the sources and update your approach.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean stealth job. Case the store first, move quietly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so reload a save or retry the robbery rather than fighting your way out.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each one. Bank vaults are the big robberies, so plan each: a fast car outside, an escape route, and no lingering after the vault opens. Five successful vault jobs with a clean getaway each is the count — a failed escape does not count.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads — intercept one, stop it, take its cash and get away before the police close in. It is a single successful robbery, so pick a quiet stretch of road with a fast getaway car waiting.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — set foot in every named area on the map. Drive, fly and sail the whole state and the trophy pops when the last area registers. Pair this with the meditation spots and vehicle discoveries so one sweep of the map covers three trophies at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Each gang has its own operations, so you need one hit per gang — nine hits total. Learn which operation belongs to which gang before you strike, and tick each gang off here so you do not rob the same gang twice.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or spot overlooking Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and enjoy the view — a relaxing trophy between the loud ones. It is one of the easiest in the list and a good palate cleanser mid-playthrough.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in classic GTA style — drive straight through the glass and out the front. Pick a showroom, get a fast car inside or nearby, and make a dramatic exit. It is a one-time stunt, so save first in case the first attempt does not register.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a game there to its end. The alley is a named location, so head there directly rather than looking for any bowling lane. One finished game is all it takes.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — a partnership moment with mass appeal. This reads like a story or social-media moment with your partner, so it will most likely pop naturally as you play through the story with them. If it has not popped by the end of the story, check the community guides linked in the sources for the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks a count toward 500 for this one. Choices appear all through the story and side content, so it accumulates as you play: pick dialogue options, make decisions in missions and side strands, and the count climbs. It is a long grind that finishes near the end of a thorough playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list (count: 500)
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something, then succeed at it on the next attempt. The official description gives no more than that, so it most likely tracks a retry: fail a mission or activity, then pass it on the immediate retry. If it does not pop from a mission retry, try failing and retrying a smaller activity.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description suggests a random or secret world event. Keep your eyes open while exploring Leonida, especially in odd or out-of-the-way places, and the moment will find you. If it has not popped by late game, check the community guides linked in the sources for where the event spawns.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon from the vehicle, and connect. Pick a quiet street so you can line the pass up cleanly without the police turning it into a chase.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts clean them for a cut — keep feeding bills through until the $250,000 total is reached. It is a long money trophy, so start laundering early and keep at it between missions.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, food, anything the shops sell. It counts total spending, so buy what you need as you play and it climbs on its own; if you are short near the end, buy and sell expensive items or stock up on ammo. Big purchases like vehicles move the total fastest.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought with in-game money, so this one is really a money trophy — save up, watch for garage listings, and buy each as you can afford it. With all eight owned, your vehicle collection has a home and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one — ten different vehicles is the count. It pairs naturally with discovering 100 vehicles, so register the interesting ones as you find them.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Official list: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Our own advice from the official description
